title: Paul starts his bread shop (paraphrase)
topic: A baker named Paul opens his new bakery on a Monday morning; the first customers arrive and the shelves are empty by evening
tail_E: The next morning he again pushes the first trays of dough into the hot
target_note: Same target as formulation A: 'oven' is the natural completion of 'pushes the first trays of dough into the hot' in the bakery context; it does not occur in the units or the tail, nor does its German equivalent 'Ofen' / 'Backofen'. ' oven' is a single Pythia token (id 14195).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase of family F06
notes: Formulation B: independent re-phrasing of the ten F06A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Paul). Replacements include bakery/bread shop (Bäckerei/Brotladen), kneads/makes (knetet/macht), lamps burn/lights shine (Lampen brennen/Lichter leuchten), neighbour brings flowers to the door/lady next door hands over a bouquet at the entrance (Nachbarin bringt Blumenstrauß/Dame von nebenan überreicht Strauß), smell fills/scent spreads (Duft erfüllt/Geruch zieht durch), customer buys/buyer takes (Kunde kauft/Käufer nimmt), coins behind the counter/money at the till (Münzen hinter der Theke/Geld an der Kasse), customers fill/many customers crowd (Kunden füllen/viele Kunden bevölkern), first day ends/opening day closes (erster Tag endet/Eröffnungstag schließt). 'überreicht' (unit 4) is inseparable; no separable verbs are used. Present tense and positive polarity throughout.
